But keep in mind the Lord your God: for it is he who gives you the power to get wealth
so that he may give effect to the agreement which he made by his oath with your fathers
as at this day.

The Word became flesh
and lived among us. We saw his glory
such glory as of the one and only Son of the Father
full of grace and truth.
And so the Word became flesh and took a place among us for a time; and we saw his glory--such glory as is given to an only son by his father--saw it to be true and full of grace.
